text:
amanda: Heads-up: post-launch grooming in 20. QA flagged an onboarding UI polish bundle, a streaming perf regression on hosted API, a rare dedicated routing 502, and two enhancements (rollout toggle + token telemetry). Need to decide hotpatch vs backlog.

reza: Paste the QA notes and rough effort please. we'll judge by customer impact and rollback risk.

amanda: QA summary: 6 issues — 4 UI (permission modal layout, empty-state copy, primary button focus, mobile overflow), 1 routing 502 repro, 1 embedding tokenization edge-case. Enhancements: canary rollout toggle, token-level telemetry. Estimates: UI fixes ~1 dev-day if CSS/strings only; routing/perf unknown but urgent; enhancements next sprint.

ben: If streaming is regressing that's high-risk. I'll triage traces now. Any staging repro?

lia: UX note: issues are in onboarding; visible but not data-loss. I can scope fixes to be presentational to keep risk low.

reza: Proposed: 1) Hotpatch routing + streaming perf if triage shows config/regression (owner: ben). 2) Canary for 4 UI fixes if low-risk (owner: lia + FE). 3) Schedule toggles & telemetry next sprint. Objections?

lia: +1. I'll add a quick a11y check for the modal. Can do design review in ~4 hours.

ben: Starting traces  hypothesis: KV cache invalidation or kernel selection change for longer seqs. If config we can hotpatch in hours; kernel/model-level change needs gated rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for branch "onboard-ui-canary" at 15:30 UTC  awaiting approvals.

amanda: Recap: (A) hotpatch routing/perf (ben)  go/no-go after triage; (B) UI canary for 4 low-risk fixes (lia + FE)  run canary and smoke; (C) toggle + telemetry next sprint. I'll update tickets with rollback steps.

reza: I'll update roadmap board and label tickets: hotpatch/ship, next-sprint, needs-design.

ben: Ops note: redact token-level logs during canary. For gated deploy: `./deploy --canary --feature-gate=onboard-ui-canary`.

lia: I'll prepare screenshot diffs and a short QA checklist. @marta can you run visual regression after canary?

marta: I can reproduce the routing 502 locally with the repro steps; will run full regression post-canary and report.

amanda: Scheduling a 15-min sync in 10 to confirm owners and rollback. Agenda: risk, timeline, verification. I'll post updated ticket numbers after the call. Thanks everyone!
